basics.name: Michael Galbraith Purvis
basics.label: AI Solution Architect | Agentic Workflows & AI-Native Business Systems
basics.summary: AI Solution Architect with 15+ years of software engineering experience, now focused on helping coaches, consultants, and service businesses redesign operations around AI.. I assess where AI creates the highest ROI, then design and implement end-to-end agentic workflows — automating lead generation, client onboarding, content pipelines, and decision-making so businesses scale without adding headcount. I built and launched Agentic Tarot as a proof-of-concept fully autonomous AI business: AI-generated personalized readings, automated commerce, and AI-driven marketing — zero staff, running 24/7. My engineering background means I deliver enterprise-grade solutions, not surface-level tool stacks: clean architecture, reliable systems, and AI workflows that actually hold up under real business load.

projects.name: Agentic Tarot
projects.summary: Designed and built a fully agentic online business from the ground up — an AI-powered tarot reading platform where every layer of the stack is orchestrated by AI agents. Claude-powered agents handle reading generation, personalization, and contextual narrative; a Stripe-integrated storefront manages commerce end-to-end; automated content pipelines drive SEO and social distribution. The system operates with minimal human intervention, demonstrating applied AI architecture across inference, workflow orchestration, payment processing, and growth automation.
